headline: Mongolia imported petroleum products worth $2.6 billion
summary: Mongolia imported petroleum products worth $2.65 billion in the first ten months of the year, including 1.7 million tons of diesel and 756.4 thousand tons of motor gasoline.
why: Mongolia relies heavily on imported fuel, so its petroleum import bill affects the trade balance and domestic fuel prices. Import volumes also indicate economic activity.
